summary.text: Chynah Tyler is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Suffolk District since January 4, 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Chynah Tyler assumed office in the 7th Suffolk District on January 4, 2017.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the House Ways and Means Committee and the Health Care Financing, Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy, and Ways and Means joint committees, and as vice chair of the State Administration and Regulatory Oversight Joint Committee.
